entities.name: Fátima Ferreira
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fátima Ferreira-Briza is a Brazilian-Austrian biologist, biochemist and educator. Since 2010, she has been Professor of Molecular Biology at the University of Salzburg, Austria, where, since October 2011, she has also been Vice-Rector for Research with responsibility for the Faculty of Natural Sciences.

entities.summary: Fátima Ferreira-Briza is a Brazilian-Austrian biologist, biochemist and educator.
